text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's show time!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer, shall we end this year on a
brilliant
note with dinner and an opera?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's Eve, and T.M. Opera O
has
reserved the academy's cafeteria to
throw a
party.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Only one reporter came to the
press
conference following my debut.
Still unthinkable
when I think back on
it...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But it's the perfect device. You give the

appearance of an empty house, only for
the show
to be revealed as a sold-out hit
at the last
moment!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I have kept you in suspense long
enough! Here I
am, the star of today's
event! Let the celebration
begin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Why are you the only one
present?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'm here too...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O, um... Thank you for everything
this past
year...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And Doto?! This pattern is starting to
get stale...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Has my rise in popularity remained
stagnant the
entire time?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alas, what a dark turn of events. Woe is
me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Opera O's shoulders sink. Well, this lack
of
turnout would get anyone down.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How can I still be so unnoticed? The true
hero
Lohengrin stands before them, and
yet I get
nothing!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why do their eyes not turn to this knight
of the
holy grail? Perhaps, they are
simply unaware? If
that is the case...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I must dominate on the
racecourse, and
you must direct my
path!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The disappointment doesn't discourage
her in the
slightest. That's what I call the
heart of a top star.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... Opera O? There's, uh, a certain
reason
nobody came today.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Maybe... I mean, at least I think it's because everyone's... over there.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Over there, as in... where?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone! Welcome to the New
Year's Eve
Umamusume Fan
Extravaganza!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And we've got some big names with us
today!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
First, two powerhouses from the recent
Japan
Cup, El Condor Pasa and Special
Week!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hello, hello! Did ya see me knock out
the
competition?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I did my real best! I mean, I placed third,
but
still...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Next up, two faces you can expect to
see in the
coming Arima Kinen, Grass
Wonder and Seiun
Sky!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Merry evening to ya.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! So, they had conspired to throw
another
event? Yes, now I see!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A show to celebrate those four of the
generation
before mine, the Golden
Generation.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fooled into thinking four is better than
one on
numbers alone, fans flocked to
that party instead.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Despite me having more appeal than all of them combined.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait just a moment. If I were to
insert myself
into their gathering...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It would throw their plans off the rails,
but they
shall gain something much
grander. How
beneficial for everyone!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is settled! I must go, for the greater
good—and
to fulfill my duty as a star!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Greetings, one and all!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O... Waaait! Don't interrupt
them... It won't
end well...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It takes all the strength we can muster,
but
Meisho Doto and I get Opera O to
return.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So, we have retreated to this castle of
silence,
hm?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Those three on the other side have
records of
discernible achievement.
Naturally, they would
draw a crowd.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But lo! The main actor has only just
taken the
stage!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is high time they make notice of me. I
will help
correct their vision.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Trainer. Have you heard the
saying,
"Speak of next year, and the
devil will laugh"?
choice_data_list_en: We'll turn the tables next year.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, before the devil has the chance,
I'll be the
one laughing instead! Next
year, this hall will be
packed to the
doors with my fans!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! Aaaaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It's way past dinner time. Hopefully the cafeteria is still open.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha hah!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Is that... laughter? But whose?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha hah!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's... T.M. Opera O?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Hard pass. I'll pretend I didn't see
anything...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! Look at this, a fan in the flesh!
One of my
fans has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Tch! She saw me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, welcome! Eat, drink, and
enjoy my solo
show to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'd rather not...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What's this? You're... Admire Vega.
You're of my
same generation.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You look absolutely dreadful. Come,
replenish
yourself with my charm. There's
plenty to go
around!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Save your breath, really...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, with a hapless Admire Vega
dragged
along, our final event of the
year comes to a cozy
finish.
